stem: Two masses m₁ and m₂ connected by an inextensible cord, m₁ sliding on a frictionless surface and m₂ hanging from a light frictionless pulley. Mass of the falling mass m₂ if m₁ and tension T are known? (a) T/g (b) Tm₁/(gm₁−T) (c) (m₁g−T)/g (d) None —
